blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A male worker was killed while eight others were injured after rocks suddenly fell and struck them inside a tunnel in Antipolo City on Wednesday. The rockslide occurred at 3:20 p.m. inside the main access tunnel of PowerChina’s water and hydropower infrastructure project in Barangay Calawis, the Calabarzon police said on Thursday.
